Everything in Aether

A chat app for the people you actually talk to. All of it free.

💬 Messaging

  • DMs, group chats and servers with text channels, threads and forums
  • Replies, reactions, polls, GIFs, stickers, big emoji and markdown
  • Voice messages: hold to record, slide to lock, read them as text
  • Translate any message on your device
  • Edit with history, pins, saved messages, scheduled messages and reminders
  • Drafts that follow you between devices, and sending that works offline
  • Chat folders, pins and archive to keep your list tidy

🎧 Calls

  • Voice and video calls in DMs, groups and voice channels
  • Screen sharing up to 1080p at 60 fps, with sound
  • Noise suppression and quality that adapts to your connection
  • Watch YouTube together, soundboard and a floating call bubble on phones

✨ Together

  • Moments: 24-hour photos, videos and notes with a ring around your avatar
  • Close friends list for Moments only some people should see
  • Birthdays (never the year) with a reminder for your friends
  • Shared lists anyone in a chat can tick off
  • Tic-tac-toe and Connect Four in any chat

🎮 Games and music

  • Detects installed games (Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Xbox) and shows your play time
  • Playing, Locked in and AFK modes from a dropdown or a keybind
  • “Played this week” on your profile, hidden or cleared whenever you like
  • Ask to join a friend's game with one tap
  • Spotify status with the right album cover, and a mini-player on Windows

🎨 Make it yours

  • Layouts: Classic, Orbit, Lounge, Workspace, or a custom one you drag and resize
  • Dozens of themes with gradients and moving backgrounds, plus a few secret ones
  • Hundreds of nameplates, avatar decorations, frames, name effects and banners
  • A photo editor: crop, filters, drawing and text
  • 19 languages, including Arabic and Urdu right to left
  • Your settings, theme and layout sync to every device you sign in on

🏰 Communities

  • Roles and permissions, categories, events, announcements and welcome screens
  • AutoMod, slow mode, timeouts, bans and an audit log
  • Custom emoji, stickers, soundboard sounds and server levels
  • Webhooks, a built-in bot, and apps you can build with the bot API

🔒 Privacy and safety

  • Optional end-to-end encryption for DMs and groups, files included
  • Disappearing messages, quiet hours and per-chat sounds
  • Two-factor sign-in, passkeys, backup codes and a list of your devices
  • Blocking, message requests, reports, and control over who can add you
  • Download all your data or delete your account any time

🧑‍💻 For developers

  • Create apps in Settings → Developer and post through the bot API
  • Slash commands delivered to your server as signed requests
  • Discord-compatible incoming webhooks
